verdict.rationale: Tavily publishes a public pricing page with a credit-based model: 1,000 free API credits per month, no credit card required, and 'pay only for what you use'. A community user also describes it as a paid per-search API, so self-serve, usage-based pricing without a sales conversation is evidenced. However, the pack never shows the actual dollar price per credit or how many credits each request type consumes. missing for 10: explicit per-credit/per-request dollar rates, credit cost per endpoint (search/extract/crawl/research), paid tier details showing no sales contact is needed.
